findings.claim: The resolution functions this suite exercises are declared inside the same test file and are invoked by nothing else, so the test proves its own Go mirror of the documented rule rather than any shipped behavior. findings.claim: The demoted-terminator case's document also contains a heading at the carve-out's own level, which trips the span-integrity guard before the loop can reach end of document. Because the case asserts only the shared sentinel and an empty return, and the end-of-document path returns that same sentinel, it cannot distinguish a working span-integrity guard from an absent one. It does still catch a level-blind terminator match, which is the bug its name targets, but it does not isolate the mechanism the way the two neighbouring cases do.

findings.claim: The fixture value is compared with exact float equality against a source literal. This is deterministic today because both sides are correctly-rounded parses of the same decimal text with no arithmetic on either side, but the assertion carries no tolerance and would regress silently if either side ever became computed rather than parsed.
